items.title: Why Is Aon (AON) Combining Its Specialty Businesses Under One Brand?
items.summary: Aon (NYSE:AON) plans to launch Totalis Specialty Group, combining NFP Totalis Program Underwriters and Aon Affinity’s U.S. programs business under one brand. The new unit will align specialty underwriting, program administration, and distribution under a single approach. Totalis Specialty Group will oversee more than US$5.5b in U.S. premium volume within Aon’s specialty business.
